howToCancel.question: How do I cancel
howToCancel.answer:
Cancel anytime through your phone settings, not inside Lexie. Apple handles the subscription so I can't cancel it for you.

On iPhone: Settings → tap your name → Subscriptions → Lexie → Cancel.
On Android: Play Store → profile → Payments and subscriptions → Subscriptions → Lexie → Cancel.

Bought on lexielearn.com instead? Then the stores don't know about your subscription. Go to Settings → Manage subscription in the app and it takes you to the right place.

You keep access until the end of the period you already paid for.

webPurchaseLogin.question: I bought Pro on the website, how do I get it in the app?
webPurchaseLogin.answer:
Log in with the same email you used when you bought it. In the app: Settings → Account, or tap the log in link on the paywall. You'll get a 6-digit code by email, no password needed. Once you're in, your Pro Pass unlocks automatically.

Note that Restore purchases only finds App Store and Google Play purchases. For a web purchase, logging in is the way.

One honest caveat: logging in brings your Pro Pass, not your study sets. Sets you made on the web stay on the web for now.

shareWithKid.question: How do I share with my kid?
shareWithKid.answer:
Get the family annual plan. It covers up to 6 devices through Apple's Family Sharing, so your kid (or anyone in your family group) gets full access on their own phone.

Set up Family Sharing in iPhone settings first if you haven't, then buy the family plan from inside Lexie. Everyone in the family group gets it automatically.

Heads up: family plans are iPhone only, Google Play doesn't support family sharing for subscriptions. On Android, or a mixed iPhone/Android family? Message me and we'll figure it out.

freeTierRunsOut.question: What happens when free tier runs out?
freeTierRunsOut.answer:
The 3 study sets you made stay. You can keep reviewing them, listening, doing flashcards, all of it. You just can't make new ones until you either upgrade or earn more sets through referrals.

Invite a friend, you both get 2 free sets when they join.

openWhatsappSet.question: How do I open a study set created in WhatsApp/website in the app?
openWhatsappSet.answer:
Right now you can't. Study sets don't move between the web and the app yet, even if you log in with the same email. Logging in unlocks your Pro Pass in the app, but your content stays where you made it.

If you want a set in the app, easiest thing is to take a photo of the same material and let Lexie generate it there. If syncing is something you'd actually use, message me and let me know. It helps me decide what to build next.

multiDevice.question: Can I use Lexie on more than one device?
multiDevice.answer:
Study sets live on the phone they were made on, so they don't sync between phones automatically. Each phone is its own little island.

If you want a set on another phone, share it from the original (tap Share → Send link) and open it on the other one.

You can also open shared links in a browser on your laptop, no app needed, just tap the link. Handy if you want to study on a bigger screen.

Your Pro Pass does travel, though. A web purchase unlocks on any phone once you log in, and store purchases follow your App Store or Google Play account.

tips.tip1Description: The app works faster with fewer images and creates more focused practice questions. You can always create another set later.
tips.tip2Description: Mixing math with history in the same set? The questions get messy. Keep each set focused on what you're studying right now.
tips.tip3Description: Blurry text = confused AI = weird questions. Make sure your notes or textbook pages are well-lit and in focus.
